# Event taxonomy

Naming: `<module>.<aggregate>.<past_tense_verb>`. Events are written to the transactional outbox in the same transaction as the state change and delivered at least once (handlers are idempotent). A version increases on a breaking payload change.

Envelope: `{ id, tenantId, eventType, version, aggregateType, aggregateId, actor, payload, causationId, occurredAt }`.
